dct_description_sm: Laser ablation ICP-MS data for ablation maps of Mn crusts from the Mariana Arc. Data in support of the paper "Formation of layered ferromanganese precipitates from the southern Mariana Arc, West Pacific, based on micron-scale variations in geochemistry". The data consists of an excel spreadsheet with 6 tabs. Each tab represents a LA-ICP-MS map. The data has x-y coordinates and concentrations of elemental data.
dct_title_s: Formation of layered ferromanganese precipitates from the southern Mariana Arc, West Pacific, based on micron-scale variations in geochemistry
